description.value: The T-Bar & Grill is a classic sports bar and comfort-food grill situated at the base of the slopes at Panorama Mountain Resort, a major year-round mountain destination in BC's Kootenay Rockies that includes an active mountain biking program. It serves as the social hub of the resort village, featuring local craft beers on tap and a hearty menu of burgers, wings, and poutine. Cyclists riding at Panorama will find it a natural end-of-day stop, with a summer patio service on the Alto Patio.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the T-Bar & Grill at Panorama Mountain Resort (2000 Panorama Dr, Panorama V0A 1T0, phone +1 250-341-3055), a bar/grill at the base of the ski/bike slopes. The menu explicitly marks items as vegetarian (v), vegan (vg), and gluten-free (gf), and the site lists 'Takeaway' as a service. No evidence is available for bike-specific amenities such as racks, water refill, or washrooms on the T-Bar page itself, though the resort prominently offers bike lessons and rentals indicating it is a cycling-active destination.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'The T-Bar' but the website consistently calls it 'T-Bar & Grill'. The OSM name has been preserved per instructions, but this should be verified.
OSM record has no phone or address tags; both were sourced from the website and are unconfirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate bar and grill at an active mountain biking and ski resort in the Kootenays; a touring or trail cyclist at Panorama would directly benefit from this listing, and the venue offers takeout and multiple dietary options.
enrichment_extras.notes: Panorama Mountain Resort offers bike lessons, equipment rentals, and trail access, making the resort village a plausible stop for mountain and touring cyclists. Bike-specific amenities for the T-Bar itself (racks, pump, water) are not mentioned on the venue page and should be verified on-site.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks multiple items with dietary codes: 'v' (vegetarian) on Nachos and Mountain Poutine; 'vg' (vegan) on Battered Mushrooms and Truffle Fries (with vegan dill); 'gf' (gluten-free) on Chicken Wings, Mountain Poutine, Nachos, and Beef Dip. Also notes 'Vegetarian options available - Beyond Meat' under the burger section

wow_evidence: major year-round mountain destination in BC's Kootenay Rockies that includes an active mountain biking program
